**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 hits the preferred position on every material term of the LICENSE rule:

- **Affiliates and contractors** — §13.1 grants access rights directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with no written-notice precondition (better than the fallback). §13.2 extends the paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates and permits contractors to support the material.
- **Not revocable at will** — §13.2 makes paid-up/embedded licences "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid." §13.3 bars Vendor from revoking or suspending any licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **Transferability** — §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in connection with a Section 24 permitted assignment.
- **No back-door revocation** — Section 9 termination rights require uncured material breach (§9.1); §9.4 is a Customer-favourable without-cause right, so no flag.
